angles.label: PMP grouped case-study scenarios (3-5 questions per project)
angles.source: PMI exam-format announcement + cert-prep blogs (PM Mastery, ExamCert, OpenExamPrep) covering July 9 launch
angles.outlierSignal: Format change is the freshest angle hitting cert-prep blogs this week — case sets replace standalone Qs. Topic-hot across PMP prep publishers.
angles.whyHot: Six weeks out, candidates realize a wrong call on Q1 of a set poisons Q2-5. Anxiety spike on r/pmp study threads.
angles.angleForBrad: Run one fake PMI case set live — AI shows how the reasoning chain compounds: if you mis-frame the project as predictive, you fail all 4 follow-ups.

angles.label: SHRM kills remote proctoring for 2026 — Prometric centers only
angles.source: SHRM 2026 BASK + Pocket Prep / CriticalThinkHR coverage (competitor authored — handoff flag)
angles.outlierSignal: Format shock: candidates who planned home testing now scrambling for Prometric slots. AI governance questions still expanding across 5 functional areas.
angles.whyHot: Logistics panic + content-scope anxiety stacked together. Plays into the 'one shot, get it right' angle.
angles.angleForBrad: Lead with the Prometric-only headline, pivot: if you only get one shot in a testing center, reasoning under pressure beats memorization. Demo AI Tutor on an Inclusive Mindset scenario.

angles.label: CompTIA SecAI+ launch reshapes the Security+ ladder
angles.source: CompTIA 2026 reshape announcement (SecAI+, Security+ refresh, Xpert series) + Training Camp SY0-801 preview ~Oct 20
angles.outlierSignal: New cert tier (SecAI+) plus SY0-801 preview window both 2026. Candidates ask 'is Security+ still the right starting cert?' in r/CompTIA threads.
angles.whyHot: Decision fatigue: 701 now, 801 later, or wait for SecAI+. Brad can own the 'reasoning skills transfer across all three' position.
angles.angleForBrad: Stop chasing the cert calendar. Show CipherExam reasoning a 701 LLM-threat question the same way it'll reason an 801 or SecAI+ question — the engine doesn't care which version you sit for.

skipThese: Generic SHRM AI+HI specialty credential hype — supplementary cert, not exam prep, no opening for the reasoning engine.
handoffNote: Pocket Prep and CriticalThinkHR are both publishing on 2026 SHRM BASK changes this week. cipher-competitor-analyst should review Pocket Prep's framing before Brad drafts Angle 2 — risk of echoing competitor copy.
